identity.operation: Parse and render a spoiler span through md_html.
identity.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the input contains ||text||.
identity.capability: Recognize double-pipe delimiters and emit x-spoiler tags.
identity.consequence: The spoiler span is not rendered as a spoiler.

requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, recognize ||text|| and render the span with x-spoiler tags.

assessment.necessity_reason: The harness can supply the spoiler flag and ||text|| bytes, but the omitted call path prevents an end-to-end reachability finding for this frozen obligation.

before.requirement: Recognize and render a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum has no spoiler type, and the before collector treats pipes as table or wiki-link marks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector creates only single-pipe marks in its pipe handler.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, recognize ||text|| and emit x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag, delimiter handling, span callbacks and HTML tags are supplied. The omitted analysis caller path is decisive for establishing that the harness input reaches them.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the flag that enables spoiler spans.
Collects double-pipe marks when the spoiler flag is set.
Analyzes double-pipe marks within link contents.
Turns resolved double-pipe marks into spoiler span callbacks.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles the harness and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

assessment.comparison_reason: The spoiler contract did not exist before the change. Afterward, the old harness supplies the required flag and bytes, but the supplied source does not establish their complete route to spoiler resolution.
missing_information: Complete before and after md_analyze_inlines bodies and the relevant md_process_doc caller path in src/md4c.c.

necessity_evidence.reason: The old harness can supply the spoiler flag and delimiter text to md_html. The supplied source defines the spoiler span and renders its opening and closing tags. The claimed harness coverage blocker is refuted.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: An input consisting of the native unsigned representation of 0x10000, the native unsigned representation of renderer flags 0, then the bytes ||text||.

scope_contract.reason: Spoiler spans are part of the parser format handled by the harness's md_html operation.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry calls md_html with input supplied parser flags and document bytes.

feasible_trigger.reason: The input can set MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in the first unsigned word and place ||text|| after the two flag words.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry takes both flags and the remaining document from fuzz input.
md_html passes the supplied parser flags into its parser configuration.
The flagged parser collects double pipes as potential spoiler delimiters.

observable_consequence.reason: The claimed unreachable spoiler behavior has a supported input route. Resolved double pipes produce spoiler span callbacks, whose HTML handlers emit x-spoiler tags. The harness discards callback output, but that does not block execution of rendering.

evidence.dependency_reason: Resolved double pipes invoke spoiler span callbacks.
The opening callback renders the spoiler tag.
The closing callback renders the matching tag.
The output callback discards emitted text; it does not prevent the renderer from calling it.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The candidate's equivalent route is present: fuzz bytes control the parser flag and document passed to md_html. There is no fixed harness flag or document format excluding the witness.

evidence.dependency_reason: md_html accepts and forwards the harness supplied parser flags.
The spoiler flag is an unsigned parser flag bit.

identity_preserved.reason: The same spoiler span tuple is assessed on both versions. The before span enum lacks a spoiler type; the after enum adds it, and the old harness remains the entry used for the comparison.

evidence.dependency_reason: The fixed old entry is the harness for both source versions.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Analyzes double-pipe marks in link contents.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this entry and links the HTML renderer and parser.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, parse ||text|| as a spoiler span and render x-spoiler tags.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Pass the spoiler flag and a document containing ||text|| to md_html.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The first input unsigned word supplies parser flags; bytes after two unsigned words supply the document to md_html.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None: the frozen spoiler behavior is reachable through the old entry.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The direct md_html call accepts input controlled parser flags and document bytes.
